The '''Walkway Collective''' was a resistance group of around one hundred [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], established after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. It was centered around the [[Catier Walkway]] and led by [[Tenga Javik]]. [[Yassat]] was a scout for the group.

[[Skiffer]] was a member of a rival group who attacked and ate members of the Walkway Collective.
